decisions.statement: A registration names the link an event is dispatched through rather than a hook.
One registration answers for every hook running at that event.
The registration matches every tool, and which hook runs is settled at the call.
A client reads the settings document once at spawn and never again.
A path written here names no checkout, so a moving tree leaves it true.
The links are put in place here, before any registration names one.
An index naming no agent hook is refused rather than answered empty.
An agent hook whose code file is absent is refused by name.
An agent hook naming no event registers nothing rather than refusing the spawn.
A hook parked that way is the one hook parked rather than the whole fleet.
What a hook page carries is read from the index rather than by loading the page.

definition: what the agent hook pages register with a client at spawn
